import andes
import numpy as np

ssa = andes.load(
    andes.get_case('ieee14/ieee14_full.xlsx'),
    setup=True,
    no_output=True,
)

ssa.PFlow.run()

bus_ids = [str(bus_id) for bus_id in ssa.Bus.idx.v]
bus_v = np.asarray(ssa.Bus.v.v, dtype=float)
top_indices = np.argsort(bus_v)[-3:][::-1]

print(f"Slack bus voltage: {float(ssa.Slack.v.v[0]):.4f} p.u.")
for rank, idx in enumerate(top_indices, start=1):
    print(f"Top {rank}: Bus {bus_ids[idx]} voltage = {bus_v[idx]:.4f} p.u.")

validation.expected_stdout:

)
